I like these because there is no screen in the bottom. I had some that had the screen in the bottom and when they are inserted incorrectly, the Keurig punches a hole in the screen. These won't let that happen. Also, these have a rubber gasket to seal the lid.

I have a K50 not the K500, so the orange one won't fit. That's my fault, but make sure you check your model before ordering. I'm happy with the two smaller, single-sized ones, so there's no need to return them.

btw, I use Folgers. Using these reusable pods, it costs me $0.30 an ounce. Using the Folgers prepackaged pods, the cost is about $1.50 an ounce. That's 5X more money than simply adding the coffee to these reusable pods.

The small purple ones work fine. The orange (carafe) one worked a couple times, but now no matter what I do the Keurig doesn't recognize it. Get the 'Oops!' message. I'm sure there is a way to get around this, but I haven't looked that far into it yet - the thing should just work. Also, if you are a fan of stronger coffee, even if you select strong (and have a good strong brew) it's still weak. This is probably a problem with how the Keurigs work, as if you use the intended wasteful 'k-cups' you can get a good strong brew.

I did not know there were shower filters available until now.  After a little research I chose this one to try out.  Reviews in other filters mentioned their inability to function with hot water. After a week of use (in fairly hot water), it is working great!  We have definitely noticed a difference with healthier feeling skin and hair.  My only concern is replacement cartridges.  I didn't see any readily available.  Hopefully they are available in a couple months.
It leaks. This product did not work for me.

This is a nice filter & was easy to install, but because it was only in chrome, we had to paint it to match our other fixtures which are bronze. If it had come in bronze, I would give it 5 stars. My hair color is so much better using this filter...no more orangey/brass tones.

Filter arrived quickly and installed easily. I ran water for a couple of minutes after installation to clear the charcoal sediment, then it ran clear.  I purchased this filter to help with the hard water spots on the shower glass.  I will update in a couple weeks once I figure out if it's made a difference.  Replacement filters need to be available.

We purchased this filter to help reduce the minerals in our well water, mainly to prevent our shower and hair from turning orange from the iron in the water. The filter unfortunately cuts down on the water pressure in the shower that we will not be able to shower this way. I tried to research different filters before purchasing but I did not think about the effectiveness of the water pressure once installed.
I am very happy with my purchase. It came on time, was easy to attach, and it doesn't slow the flow of the water at all!
You can  totally feel a different in the water. It seems like I  used to  get out the shower feeling drained, now I feel refreshed. Love this product. I just need to get more  filters.

Our well water is mineral-rich and very alkaline. We use a carbon block whole house filter but for some reason the shower retains a hydrogen sulfide odor. This shower mount filter with 2 stage carbon and KDF filtration has successfully removed the sulfur odor. In addition, soaps seem to lather better and I have noticed an improvement in the hard water scale build up. This filter has provided a simple and effective fix for a problem we have battled for years.

This is not the fault of the device, but if you are tall, it can be a bit of a challenge to shower.  The water smells better as well.  It is worth getting.

My water is pretty hard, I measured it around 350ppm-360ppm, after the filter was applied and ran for several days about 320ppm.. so it took off about 30ppm... its still pretty hard so if you have pretty hard water, like mine, you will not notice much of a difference. I might need to come up with a different solution. I would suggest measuring your water first if you have very hard water, this won't cut the mustard, bottom line.

Instant improvement in water softness. Bathing is much less drying to the skin than before. Shipping and delivery were rapid. Extra filter and plumbers tape are a nice gift.  This product appears to be identical to others offered on Amazon but at a lower price. Highly recommended.
